message: 別れと出会いの輪廻
--Four days left until parting with Lolotte.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat, is that really true!?

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san, are you really going back to Heaven with Azel-san too...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, that's right!」

name: Ria
message: 「Could you tell us why?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course, I'd be glad to!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm going to report to Heaven what happened during this Re-Crea, and everything I witnessed.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Re-Crea known in Heaven was something completely different from what it actually is.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heaven isn't safe at all... Simply acting like it doesn't concern us won't solve anything.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A situation where Re-Crea dwells within an angel--that must never happen again.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why I'm going back to tell them. Together with Azel-san and Amyrina!」

name: Ria
message: 「I see, so that's why...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're gonna come back properly, right!?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course, I'll come back!」

name: Misa
message: 「But I heard angels can't just come to the Human World so easily!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll be fine. I'll definitely come back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Even being here in the Human World like this seems to have taken some pretty reckless effort on her part.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe」

name: Synn
message: 「So she'll definitely come back.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you really okay with that, Synn...? Even though you two finally, um... started going out...」

name: Synn
message: 「We're just going to be apart, not breaking up.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haven't I told you over and over? I'll be back right away. And then I'll be able to be with everyone again.」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san...」
The worried expressions won't leave Nanaka and Misa's faces.
They probably know that Lolotte and I are stifling our loneliness and deliberately acting cheerful.
A promise woven from words alone.
Yet if I didn't do that, I would end up biting my lip.

name: Ria
message: 「If you've thought it through that much and decided on it together with Synn-kun...」

name: Ria
message: 「Then as your friends, we have to cheer you on!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see... It's not some half-baked resolve that would change just because we tried to stop you now, is it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Besides, it's not like we could ever take your place. So all we can do... is support you...」

name: Misa
message: 「...Ngh. Still, if Lolotte-san leaves, what are we going to do about the secretary?!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm sure Synn-chan will work extra hard to make up for the secretary's share as well.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Madam Chairwoman!」

name: Helena
message: 「Have you spoken to Lord Siegfried and Lady Katerina yet?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No... Not to Grandfather and the others yet...」

name: Helena
message: 「Go with Tamiko-chan and tell them properly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's right... Even Riesling-san probably doesn't want to be separated from Lolo-chan...」

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan is far more mature than someone like me, you know? She's probably even celebrating this new beginning.」

name: Misa
message: 「Celebrating, you say...」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right... This parting isn't a sad thing... We have to send her off with a smile!」

name: Misa
message: 「B-But...」

name: Helena
message: 「Now, now. If we cling to her too much, she might end up saying she won't go back after all, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-Th-That's not true at all. I've already, already... made up my mind properly...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To everyone in the Student Council, thank you so much for taking care of me all this time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Truthfully, I wanted to keep doing Student Council activities with everyone... for much, much longer...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, I'm truly sorry. And for everything up until now, thank you so very much!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so... sorry for leaving partway through. But I--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I promise! No matter what! I'll definitely come back to the Student Council!」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte... No, we're the ones who should be thanking you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not gonna say goodbye! Hurry up, finish your errands, and get right back here!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't worry about things on our end, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. I'll keep a strict eye on Synn so he doesn't go cheating on you」

name: Misa
message: 「Right, we'll have to keep a close watch on Nanaka\s10」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Hehe」

name: Ria
message: 「So Lolotte can come back whenever she wants, we all have to make sure we keep her spot safe for her」

name: Synn
message: 「...Right!」

name: Helena
message: 「Very well! However, your duties are far from over」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Holy Night Festival!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah! Let's make it an extraordinary...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's make it a super fun Holy Night Festival!!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Then, I pray for the success of the Holy Night Festival!」

name: Synn
message: 「Great work today, everyone~」

name: Everyone
message: 「Great work today!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excuse me. I have a few errands to run, so I'll be heading off first~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, Roro!?」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder what kind of errands she has...」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe she needs to get things ready for coming back?」

name: Synn
message: 「She probably has to talk to her family too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you sure, though? Even though you don't have much time left to spend with Lolo-chan...」

name: Synn
message: 「No... right now might actually be my chance.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh... Sakura-kun, d-d-don't tell me... chea--?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I was wondering if I could give Lolotte some kind of present.」

name: Synn
message: 「I actually wanted to ask everyone's advice on what kind of present would make Lolotte happy.」

name: Ria
message: 「A present, huh~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan loves the junk at your place, doesn't she? Why not just pick out something random from that?」

name: Misa
message: 「No way, that's terrible!! You have to give her a much more romantic present!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if you say that... right, Synn?」

name: Ria
message: 「Romantic, huh~~ When a boy gives a present to a girl he really likes, I guess it has to be *that*, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「What in the world is 'that'...」

name: Ria
message: 「A wedding... ring?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Wedd--Bawk?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on, Senpai!! That's way too soon!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, i-isn't that normal...? When you're dating...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Classic Ria-chan. Being so sheltered makes you super cute!!」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez! Paa-chan, stop it!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Not bad. In fact, I think it's wonderful!」

name: Misa
message: 「As expected of Onee-sama... She truly understands a maiden's heart...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Not you too, Misa-chan!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't that just your Senpai-filter talking?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not true. Even if it's not an engagement ring, a pair of matching rings carries the meaning of 'strengthening their bond.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Their bond...」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, you can always keep it right by your side」

name: Synn
message: 「A ring, huh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn... rings are pretty expensive, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, though... it's Christmas right now, so the shopping district is busy anyway...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why don't you try picking up a part-time job for the first time in a while?」

name: Synn
message: 「A part-time job...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's stop by Old Man Amakawa's place on the way home and ask」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course, you're only doing it after we finish prepping for the Holy Night Festival!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... yeah! I'll do that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Then Misa-chan and I will go look around for a shop that has cute rings」

name: Misa
message: 「And while we're at it, matching rings for me and Onee-sama too...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Umm, let's save that for another time, okay\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, everyone...」
Everyone's kindness really sinks into my heart.
It's the dead of winter.
Shooting stars are still raining down in the sky, though before long, these stars will surely turn to snow.
--Meanwhile, around that time.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excuse me! Whereabouts would the knitting books be kept?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Huh... knitting, you say? They're over in that section.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It looks like you've made a full recovery. Congratulations!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thanks to all of you. I'm truly sorry for all the trouble I caused.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not at all. We managed to get through Re-Crea safely too, so everything's A-okay!♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee... it certainly seems so. I'm truly glad that these shooting stars are no longer an omen of misfortune.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It snows in the Human World too, doesn't it?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was surprised when I first came to the Human World, too. And I remember how very cold it was.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, to keep warm--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Wawah! Please pretend you didn't hear that! Bye-bye!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I wonder what Lolotte is working on so intently...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Knitting, is it...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ufufu. It must be a present for that person.」
